experiment: Experiment 10: uncertainty resolution x covered call

inference.method: issuer-cluster (CIK) bootstrap resampling issuers with all of an issuer's events together

incremental.interpretation: Fixed-vocabulary held-issuer OLS on paired CSP net edge. Incremental value requires beating tag_only or freshness_only on the same fixed common held-issuer rows (not merely the semantic delta_only model). A missing or unmeasured resolution delta is never coerced to zero.

capacity.note: Per-leg minimum positive option volume on entry and exit on the primary matched cohort. The 1% participation figure is an illustrative assumption, not a measured fill and not a fixed capacity threshold.

note: Aggregate covered-call results only. No source filing passage, JEV probability, option-level record, 2026 record or judges artifact is included. Experiment 9B artifacts are unchanged.
